content:
No-milk alternative to Carnation Instant Breakfast?
Hello everyone!  Two of my children inherited Ectodermal Dysplasias from me, and it seems to include an intolerance to something in milk.  Not lactose, because lactose-free milk still affects us.   My youngest, who is now a year and half old, is hitting that picky eater stage.  He, like his older siblings and I, don't have much in the weight department.  He's 33" tall and 22 lbs.  Basically a beanpole with very little chub.  I want to give him something like Carnation's, but if I do, his diapers are going to be a MESS.  He drinks soy and almond milk.  Ideas, suggestions?
